prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one premium executive presentation infographic, landscape 16:9, preferably 1920x1080 or larger. Entire slide finished artwork, not a photo of a screen. Consistent visual language: near-black charcoal #121619 background, white #F4F5F6 text, muted slate panels #252B30, vivid red #FF3038 accents, thin light gray connectors with small arrowheads. Elegant modern Swiss editorial typography, generous negative space, large readable text, crisp minimalist geometric line icons. Professional restrained security technology aesthetic; no stock hacker imagery, no robots, no mascots, no birds, no logos, no company/product names, no BC-SAST or Bin Chicken, no vendor logos, no decorative pseudo-code. No invented statistics, percentages, certifications or guarantees. Each panel with simple expressive vector-like icon and short exact text only. Keep all content comfortably within 6% safe margins. Number at top right subtle. Render the quoted text verbatim. Strong visual narrative rather than dense architecture diagram. Slide number 01. Title "Security assurance across the delivery lifecycle". Subtitle "Find risk. Verify evidence. Support safer change." Three equally sized primary cards left to right, connected by a subtle horizontal line, each with icon and EXACT text: repository icon "FULL SCAN" / "Understand repository-wide risk"; code branch icon "PR DIFF SCAN" / "Review changed code in context"; collection of repositories icon "BATCH SCAN" / "Repeat the workflow across repositories". Below them a single wide charcoal inset with three compact supporting capabilities separated by thin rules: "Evidence-led verification" / "Optional remediation and testing" / "Optional provider updates". Closing value statement bottom "Actionable findings where teams work". Small footer "Coverage and validation gaps stay visible." Do not suggest these modes must run in sequence; connecting line is a shared foundation, not flow arrows.
